reasoning_content:
Now reconfigure the display-server env to point at mock backend. I'll set API_BASE_URL, TENANT, credentials. The AuthManager derives token_url by replacing '/api' -> ''. So API_BASE_URL=http://mock-backend:8002/api, tenant=tenant. Then token_url = http://mock-backend:8002/auth/signin, and base_url for ApiClient = http://mock-backend:8002/api/tenant, so /bookables -> http://mock-backend:8002/api/tenant/bookables. My mock handles endswith /bookables. Good.

Let me update .env and restart.

action.command:
cd /workspace && cat > .env <<'EOF'
API_BASE_URL = 'http://mock-backend:8002/api'
TENANT = 'tenant'
APP_USERNAME = 'user'
APP_PASSWORD = 'pass'
FETCH_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30
CLIENT_REFRESH_SECONDS = 30
FQDN=booking-service.example.com
ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com
EOF
docker compose down 2>&1 | tail -2; docker compose up -d 2>&1 | tail -3; sleep 12; echo "=== logs ==="; docker compose logs --tail=30

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > .env <<'EOF'
API_BASE_URL = 'http://mock-backend:8002/api'
TENANT = 'tenant'
APP_USERNAME = 'user'
APP_PASSWORD = 'pass'
FETCH_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30
CLIENT_REFRESH_SECONDS = 30
FQDN=booking-service.example.com
ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com
EOF
docker compose down 2>&1 | tail -2; docker compose up -d 2>&1 | tail -3; sleep 12; echo "=== logs ==="; docker compose logs --tail=30", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Restart server pointing at mock backend"}
